Issue/reproduction: Only drag or hidden keyboard route
User impact: Motor, single-pointer and voice users could not complete without dragging
Fix/decision: Visible Complete assessment button; both paths open explicit confirmation; shared guard and duplicate-submit protection
Manual/browser test result: PASS browser pointer, keyboard, touch-slider regression, cancel
Remaining risk: Physical Switch Access and voice control not tested

Issue/reproduction: Drawn stroke could assign Dre Michael automatically
User impact: Wrong signer attribution on shared device
WCAG/reference: 3.3.2; identity integrity is also a product policy concern
Fix/decision: Explicit name and consent for both methods; method/time/self-declared actor/prototype assessor/unverified identity metadata
Manual/browser test result: PASS drawn-only blocked; typed/drawn consent and reload tests
Remaining risk: Typed legal/operational equivalence needs business validation; no identity verification exists

Screen/component: Live / shared response and evidence components
Issue/reproduction: Disabled Next lacked visible blocking response reason
User impact: Unclear how to continue; screen-reader ambiguity
Fix/decision: Visible stable reason, labelled required radio group, required/invalid comment and precise photo/comment feedback
Manual/browser test result: PASS unanswered/comment/photo/both and real photo; same existing navigation/finalization guards
Remaining risk: Native screen-reader announcement timing needs device testing

Issue/reproduction: Persistence failure could still lead to apparent completion/saved status
Fix/decision: Persist receipt before completion/submission status; failure alert keeps session and confirmation available
Manual/browser test result: PASS simulated localStorage failure; no result navigation
Remaining risk: No backend/approval or guaranteed durable storage

Fix/decision: Shared shadcn close controls enlarged to 44 CSS px
Manual/browser test result: PASS measured mobile camera-sheet controls and keyboard Escape
Remaining risk: 44 px is a design aim, not the AA minimum; physical one-handed usability remains untested

Fix/decision: Shared inactive Tab text uses AA secondary token
Manual/browser test result: PASS final axe contrast in both themes and three brands
Remaining risk: Layered/background incomplete checks remain manual review items

Issue/reproduction: Heading focus plus separate live criterion announcement
Fix/decision: One focused task heading carries index/section/title/completed progress; remove duplicate task live region
Manual/browser test result: PASS browser focus and accessibility snapshots

Issue/reproduction: No return trigger ref on controlled dialog
User impact: Focus lost after cancel in Explorer
Fix/decision: Restore focus to connected initiating control; serialize pending history rewinds on rapid reopen; do not steal result focus after completion
Manual/browser test result: PASS Escape/cancel restoration in shared Explorer and flow
Remaining risk: Native AT focus behavior still requires hardware testing

Issue/reproduction: Fixed nowrap labels, metadata and header collision at 200% text
Fix/decision: Wrapping action labels, flexible station heading, constrained metadata columns, scalable tab height and input fields
Manual/browser test result: PASS 56 layout cases with no page overflow or clipped tested labels
Remaining risk: 200% text stress and 320 CSS px reflow are proxies; native 400% browser zoom not tested

Issue/reproduction: Header could consume short enlarged-text viewport
Fix/decision: Whole-sheet scroll for long acknowledgement/finish; visible focused name after Tab at 200% text in short viewport
Manual/browser test result: PASS browser short viewport focus checks
Remaining risk: Real mobile keyboard/insets require device validation

Issue/reproduction: Promised sync or manager delivery not implemented
Fix/decision: State device-local saving, no server sync, no certification, no manager send
Manual/browser test result: PASS copy review, simulated offline/online and reload
Remaining risk: Cold-start offline operation is not supported without deployed cache/service worker

User impact: Deaf/hard-of-hearing or interrupted users miss context
Fix/decision: Readable outcome, failed task list, next steps and feedback before consent; no forced agreement
Manual/browser test result: PASS shared React content and keyboard flow
Remaining risk: Readability with real users and translations still need research

Issue/reproduction: Generic hover changed selected Pass from semantic green to neutral grey
User impact: Inconsistent selected-state feedback for mouse users
WCAG/reference: Semantic design invariant; 1.4.11 review context, not a standalone audited WCAG failure
Fix/decision: Restrict hover treatment to unselected choices; retain selected semantic background/border
Manual/browser test result: Browser exact-color assertions across six theme/brand configurations
Remaining risk: Physical mouse/touch user research not performed

Issue/reproduction: No physical AT attached to environment
User impact: Mobile spoken feedback not independently verified
Fix/decision: Provide browser semantics snapshots; schedule Android TalkBack and iOS VoiceOver testing
Remaining risk: Do not claim AT compatibility or WCAG compliance based on axe/Chromium

Issue/reproduction: No approved identity or legal signing policy in prototype
WCAG/reference: Product/legal policy; not a WCAG equivalence claim
Fix/decision: Label typed acknowledgement prototype alternative; record identity as unverified and actor/assessor as prototype-only
Manual/browser test result: Prototype behavior tested; policy approval NOT VERIFIED
Remaining risk: Production identity, assisted acknowledgement and role approval require product owner decisions

Issue/reproduction: No physical handset or browser UI zoom testing
Fix/decision: 320/375/390/419, short, landscape, desktop and 200% text tests plus measured targets
Remaining risk: Physical soft keyboard, native 400% zoom, Switch Access, voice control and one-handed field testing remain open

Issue/reproduction: English sample only; no user research in sprint
User impact: Not all participants can understand sample copy
WCAG/reference: Inclusive UX research; no invented WCAG failure
Fix/decision: Plain-language feedback and no urgency timers; record translation and readability work
Manual/browser test result: Copy reviewed; user testing NOT PERFORMED
Remaining risk: Translation, supported languages, dyslexia/cognitive usability and busy-shift research remain open
